verification_instructions: Primary gate for every feature: run `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx expo lint` from the worktree root; both must pass with no errors (AC-30). This is a type/lint-only verification per NFR-3 (no test framework exists). DO NOT run `npx expo start` or any long-running dev server. Firebase runtime behaviors (real signup/login, Firestore reads/writes, Storage upload) and the storageBucket correctness can only be smoke-tested manually in Expo Go by a human; coders must note that tsc/lint passing does NOT prove runtime correctness, especially for config.ts credentials and storageBucket. For getReactNativePersistence specifically, the authoritative gate is that `npx tsc --noEmit` resolves the import under the real tsconfig; if it does not, use the AsyncStorage Persistence adapter fallback (see context key_patterns and design.md 'Decision pending install-time verification').

key_patterns: TWO-LAYER PURITY (AC-25, FR-X2/X3): pure screens in src/screens never import firebase or the pickers; Firebase/picker access lives only in src/services/firebase/*, in hooks under src/hooks/ (new dir), and in route wrappers src/app/*.tsx. Wrappers own router + useSafeAreaInsets and pass topInset/bottomInset + data + callbacks as props. SINGLETONS: only src/services/firebase/config.ts calls initializeApp/initializeAuth/getFirestore/getStorage; every other module imports the exported `app`/`auth`/`db`/`storage`. NO getAnalytics (breaks on RN; FR-X4/AC-27). AUTH SEAM: AccountContext calls auth.ts (signUp/signIn/logout/observeAuth) and NEVER imports firebase/auth directly; auth.ts is the only module besides config.ts that imports firebase/auth. ROLE: AccountRole ('elder'|'family'|'partner') in src/components/types.ts is the source of truth; users.ts normalizeRole falls back to 'family' for unknown values. PARTNER IS BLOCKED at signup in Wave 1: signUp throws sentinel Error { code: 'app/partner-not-available' } BEFORE any Firebase call, so no auth user / no users/{uid} profile is created for partner; auth-errors.ts maps that code to 'O Portal do Parceiro ainda nao esta disponivel. Em breve!'. NAVIGATION OWNERSHIP: RootNavigator in _layout.tsx is the SOLE owner of auth-state redirects; signup/login wrappers set only local submitting/errorMessage and never call router.replace to a protected route. OPTIMISTIC STATE: favorites toggle reverts only the single id on failure; review submit prepends optimistically and rethrows on failure so inputs are kept; task complete adds id optimistically and reverts on failure. getReactNativePersistence import: design decision is `import { getReactNativePersistence } from '@firebase/auth'` (RN-only export) verified by tsc; if tsc cannot resolve it for ANY reason, implement a tiny hand-written Persistence adapter over AsyncStorage (_isAvailable/_set/_get/_remove) and pass it to initializeAuth(app, { persistence: adapter }). KNOWN GOTCHA (web-confirmed): this symbol is frequently missing from editor/tsc typings even when it works at runtime and its path has varied across versions (firebase/auth, firebase/auth/react-native, @firebase/auth) — so treat the import path as install-time-verified and fall back to the adapter rather than forcing it. serverTimestamp() echoes null locally before the server round-trip, so ReviewDoc.createdAt is Timestamp|null; never call .toMillis() on it in client code (prepend optimistic items manually; order via Firestore query orderBy). CONSTANTS: do NOT normalize the 'terracota' literal in src/constants/constants.ts (its union is 'navy'|'terracota'; changing it breaks the ROLE_CONTEXT.tone literal type). .env.example is docs-only (empty values) and must never be copied to a live .env, because config.ts uses `process.env.X ?? default` and ?? only fires on undefined, not on empty string.
